sources.title: Maruti Suzuki posts record sales in Oct with 25% growth despite high base
sources.description:
India's largest passenger vehicle maker Maruti Suzuki on Sunday posted its highest-ever monthly sales in October with 25 per cent year-on-year growth in total dispatches to 2.76 lakh units, despite a high base in the year-ago period.
Domestic passenger vehicle dispatches rose over 20 per cent to 2.12 lakh units, while total domestic dispatches, which include Super Carry and sales to other OEMs, grew around 19 per cent to 2.26 lakh units, according to an exchange filing.
The strong growth despite a high base in the comparable period reflects robust demand in the market amid peak festival season. Recently, Maruti Suzuki said its inventory levels were low, with stock of around 15-16 days in dealerships and pending bookings of around 2 lakh units.

sources.title: Honda Motorcycle's total wholesale sales rise 13% to 734,000 units in Oct
sources.description:
Honda Motorcycle & Scooter India on Sunday said its total wholesale sales, including domestic and exports, rose 13 per cent year-on-year to 7.34 lakh units in October.
The automaker sold 6.50 lakh units in October 2025.
Domestic sales grew 11 per cent to 6.64 lakh units from 5.98 lakh units, while exports increased 35 per cent to 69,735 units from 51,644 units.
The Japanese automaker's total sales in April-October this year grew 15 per cent to 41.74 lakh units from 36.44 lakh units in the year-ago period.
Domestic sales increased 13 per cent to 37.08 lakh units, and exports climbed 28 per cent to 4.65 lakh units.

sources.title: Tata Motors PV sales rise 23% to 75,426 units in Oct on strong demand
sources.description:
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles on Sunday reported a 23 per cent rise in total sales to 75,426 units across domestic and international markets in October.
The company registered total sales of 61,295 units in the year-ago month.
Domestic passenger vehicle sales increased 21 per cent to 73,894 units last month from 61,134 units in October 2025, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd (TMPVL) said in a statement.
International business passenger vehicle sales jumped manifold to 1,532 units in October compared to 161 units a year ago, it added.

sources.title: Sarda Energy & Minerals Q2 results: Net profit dips 2.2% to ₹320 crore
sources.description:
Sarda Energy & Minerals has reported a 2.2 per cent decline in consolidated net profit to Rs 320 crore, mainly impacted by lower revenues.
It clocked Rs 328 crore profit after tax (PAT) in the second quarter of the preceding 2025-26 financial year, the company said in a statement on Saturday.
In July-September, the company's total income reduced by 5.7 per cent to Rs 1,505 crore from Rs 1,596 crore a year ago.
In Q2 FY2, the company's EBITDA also fell 2.7 per cent year-on-year to Rs 564 crore from Rs 580 crore in July-September of FY26.
However, in April-September, its PAT grew 4.5 per cent to Rs 799 crore from Rs 764 crore in the year-ago period.
Sarda Energy & Minerals Limited (SEML) is an integrated energy and minerals company with interests spanning power generation, mining, steel and ferro alloys.

sources.title: Escorts Kubota reports 10% decline in October sales to 16,921 units
sources.description:
Escorts Kubota Ltd on Sunday reported a 10 per cent year-on-year decline in total tractor sales to 16,921 tractors in October from 18,798 a year earlier.
Its domestic tractor sales fell 10.9 per cent to 16,412 tractors compared to 18,423 units in the year-ago period.
However, the company's exports rose 35.7 per cent to 509 units in October against 375 units in the year-ago period.
The industry witnessed some moderation in October 2026, impacted by a high base, shift in festive timing and monsoon-related disruptions. Elevated input costs due to geopolitical developments and consequent pricing actions may moderate demand in the near term, the company said in a release.

sources.title: Gross GST collections rise 23% to ₹2.31 trillion in October on strong sales
sources.description:
Gross GST collections increased 23 per cent to over Rs 2.31 lakh crore in October, driven by strong mop-up from domestic activities and imports, according to government data released on Sunday.
Gross GST collections from domestic sales rose 16 per cent to over Rs 1.59 lakh crore, and revenues from imports climbed 42 per cent to Rs 72,246 crore.
The Rs 2.31 lakh crore collection includes Central GST mop-up of 42,935 crore, State GST of Rs 51,340 crore and Integrated GST of over Rs 1.37 lakh crore, data showed.
Goods and Services Tax (GST) refunds increased 6.5 per cent year-on-year to Rs 27,934 crore in October.
After adjusting for refunds, net GST collections rose 26 per cent to over Rs 2.03 lakh crore in October.
During April-October, gross GST collection grew 13.2 per cent to over Rs 14.77 lakh crore. Net collections rose 13 per cent to over Rs 12.69 lakh crore.

sources.title: IOC, BPCL, HPCL clock ₹30,106 cr Q2 profit, nearly 39% of FY26 earnings
sources.description:
India's three state-run fuel retailers earned a combined standalone net profit of Rs 30,106 crore in the July-September quarter, nearly 39 per cent of their annual earnings, after a refining margin boost and inventory gains helped more than offset losses on fuel sales and a mounting unpaid LPG subsidy bill.
The combined profit of Indian Oil Corporation (IOC), Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Ltd (HPCL) is 68.3 per cent more than their earnings in the same period last year and a swing from a combined loss of about Rs 18,150 crore in the previous April-June quarter, according to company filings.
The July-September quarter alone equals about 39 per cent of the three companies' combined FY26 (April 2025 to March 2026 financial year) profit of Rs 77,281 crore.
The boost in earnings came despite petrol and diesel prices remaining on freeze since May and unchanged domestic LPG rates since March, despite a surge in benchmark prices and input crude

sources.title: Festive demand drives M&M vehicle sales to an all-time high in Oct
sources.description:
Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd on Sunday said its total vehicle sales grew 9 per cent year-on-year to a record 13,1109 units in October.
The total sales include exports, which rose 77 per cent to 7,102 units during the month.
Mahindra & Mahindra said domestic passenger vehicle sales rose 2 per cent year-on-year to 73,338 units in October, and commercial vehicle sales rose 4 per cent to 33,037 units.
M&M Automotive business President Velusamy R said the company's SUV sales of 73,338 units and total vehicle sales of 13,1109 units in October were the highest ever in any month.
The festive season, together with a refreshed portfolio, kept demand strong across SUVs, pick-ups and three-wheelers. Our first CNG vehicle, the XUV 3XO ZNG, has also seen strong traction with customers, he said.

sources.title: FPIs pull out ₹34,843 cr from equities in Oct, turn net buyers last week
sources.description:
Foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) withdrew Rs 34,843 crore from Indian equities in October, marking the second consecutive month of heavy outflows, amid concerns over elevated crude oil prices, global interest rates and the corporate earnings outlook.
However, foreign investors turned net buyers towards the end of the month, infusing around Rs 6,300 crore during October 26-30 compared to net outflows of nearly Rs 2,700 crore in the week ended October 23.
According to data from the Central Depository Services Ltd (CDSL), FPIs withdrew Rs 35,861 crore in September. Before that, they had invested Rs 20,200 crore in July and Rs 29,631 crore in August.
With the latest withdrawals, cumulative FPI outflows from Indian equities in 2026 have reached Rs 2.95 lakh crore.
The recent improvement in flows signals a shift in near-term sentiment, but one week of buying does not necessarily indicate a sustained reversal, market experts said.

sources.title: Hyundai Motor India sales hit record 82,299 units in October, up 17.7%
sources.description:
Hyundai Motor India Limited (HMIL) on Sunday reported its highest-ever total monthly sales, including exports, of 82,299 units in October, a 17.7 per cent year-on-year rise.
The milestone was driven by record domestic sales of 62,799 units, a 16.7 per cent rise, and exports grew 21.1 per cent to 19,500 units, the automaker said.
Tarun Garg, MD & CEO - HMIL, said, "Strong festive demand, coupled with healthy momentum in both domestic and export markets, helped us set this new sales record. Going forward, the newly launched Hyundai BAYON - our Intelligent Utility Vehicle, will provide further impetus to our growth in India as well as across 50+ export markets, reinforcing India's role as a strategic manufacturing and export hub for Hyundai".
